claims.title: Maxwell–Stefan entropy mixing at arbitrary rate, with an explicit strong-continuation boundary

quoted_fields.interface: UnitT3, equal-molar ideal isothermal/isobaric normalized Maxwell–Stefan transport without reactions, c_i>=0,sum c_i=1,sum J_i=0, symmetric positive rational f_ij and means p_i>=m>0. The same field depends only on finite input N,f,K,m,chi, not a supplied smooth future solution. Arbitrary initial zeros are allowed at the entropy-estimate scope.
quoted_fields.failure: The entropy contraction does not prove global strong solvability, higher-derivative continuation or positive-time strict positivity for unrestricted N and frictions. For weak solutions it requires the stated entropy/flux regularity supporting the comparison. Imported general weak existence and ternary strong results are credited once, not claimed as new arbitrary-component closure. The source preserves its formatting defects. No same-model counterexample, scientific novelty or new independent Capital verification is asserted.
